pricing.hero.title: We grow if you grow.
pricing.hero.copy: Start for free and activate the whole platform when you need it. Your monthly fee adjusts to your business's actual sales volume.

pricing.tiers.title: One paid plan, one fair fee
pricing.tiers.hint: You do not lose any features when changing tier: only the price changes according to your sales.
pricing.included.title: Everything included from day one
pricing.included.hint: No hidden modules or charges for each tool you activate.
pricing.paid.orders.title: Unlimited orders
pricing.paid.orders.text: Manage all your channels with no monthly limit.
pricing.paid.users.title: Users and roles

pricing.paid.kai.text: Smart assistance applied to your operation.
pricing.paid.reports.title: Advanced reports
pricing.paid.reports.text: Indicators to make decisions with real data.
pricing.paid.inventory.title: Inventory and warehouses
pricing.paid.inventory.text: Centralized control of stock and movements.
pricing.paid.logistics.title: Integrated logistics
pricing.paid.logistics.text: Shipments, deliveries and traceability in a single flow.
pricing.paid.integrations.title: Integrations
pricing.paid.integrations.text: Connect your current channels and tools.
pricing.paid.automation.title: Automations
pricing.paid.automation.text: Reduce manual tasks and operational errors.
pricing.steps.title: Katuq adapts to your business
pricing.steps.one.title: You sell as usual
pricing.steps.one.text: Operate with the whole platform without counting users or orders.
pricing.steps.two.title: We calculate your sales
pricing.steps.two.text: At the end of the cycle we automatically identify your tier.
pricing.steps.three.title: You pay what is fair
pricing.steps.three.text: Your fee matches the volume you actually processed.

pricing.cancel.text: The downgrade is immediate: you will lose the Premium features and no new automatic charges will be made. Your data will stay in Katuq.
